note: Window Controls is an AZJ2 build of BlueScorpioVR's gxr_window_curvature that reuses the same module ID; keep separate Borderless and Rotation modules off when using it.

modules.name: Galaxy XR borderless app windows (AZJ2)
modules.about: Hides app window rims and shows the caption pill only while pointing at it. AZJ2 firmware; installs disabled.

modules.name: Galaxy XR curvature recovery
modules.about: Exports logs and acknowledges curvature or borderless quarantine after a full reboot. Action only; no startup hook.

modules.name: Galaxy XR mic gain boost (AZJ2)
modules.about: Adjusts microphone gain for selected recording modes. AZJ2 port of BreadDoesStuff module; installs disabled.

modules.name: Galaxy XR no low-light toast (AZJ2)
modules.about: Suppresses the low-light signal while retaining the dim-light pipeline. AZJ2 port; installs disabled.

modules.name: Galaxy XR passthrough anywhere (AZJ2)
modules.about: Toggles camera passthrough in an immersive app with a double-tap. AZJ2 port; installs disabled.

modules.name: Galaxy XR Curvature + Borderless + Rotation (AZJ2)
modules.about: Combined AZJ2 curvature, borderless rims, hover caption and pitch/yaw/roll controls. Keep separate Borderless and Rotation off; installs disabled.

modules.name: Galaxy XR window rotation (AZJ2)
modules.about: Standalone pitch, yaw and roll controls for app windows. Installs disabled; keep off when using the combined window package.
